program.name: Women, Infants, and Children (WIC)
program.description:
WIC gives free healthy food and nutrition support. It helps pregnant and breastfeeding women, new moms, babies, and children under age 5.

You'll get a WIC card to buy approved foods like milk, eggs, fruits, and vegetables. WIC also offers nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and referrals to health care.

WIC requires a nutrition need. We can't check this for you, but WIC staff will check it during your certification appointment.

To get started, submit the online interest form. A local WIC agency will contact you to schedule your certification appointment.

documents.text: Proof of identity (ex: photo ID for adults; birth certificate for children)
Proof of Missouri residency (ex: utility bill, rent or mortgage receipt, voter registration card, or pay stub with your address)
Proof of income from the last 30 days (not needed if you get SNAP, Temporary Assistance, or qualifying MO HealthNet)

navigators.description: TEL-LINK provides confidential information and referrals for maternal and child health services. Call or text to find your closest WIC provider.
